mentions.name: Closer
mentions.description: A sales copilot that helps startups move deals faster by summarizing deal activity and preparing the next action, saving time and enabling users to close more customers. Positioned as 'Cursor for sales'.
mentions.problem: Sellers spend precious time summarizing deal activity and figuring out next steps, which slows down closing deals.
mentions.audience: startups that want to move deals faster and close more customers
mentions.source_excerpt:
A sales co pilot that helps startups move deals faster. 
You can think of it of Cursor for sales. It knows to perfectly summarise deals activity and prepare the next action. Saving you precious time and enables you to close more customers faster
